Title: A Place to Return To
Text:
Now that I've unpacked my furniture, I should register my room as a home. This will allow me to return here easily, wherever I am in Gramados.

I can use '!setHome <name>' to register my current location as a home. I can choose any name I like.
CompleteText: I've registered a home! I no longer need to remember the way back to the State Hotel every time I go somewhere.
